visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands lifts a golden-brown, glistening loaf of pull-apart bread out of a rectangular stainless steel container lined with white parchment paper. The setting is a clean, bright kitchen with a white marble countertop. (2) The hands use a white plastic bench scraper to divide soft, pale dough on the marble surface. Several other small portions of dough are visible in the background. (3) The hands roll the dough into uniform round balls. In the background, a digital scale and a calculator sit on the white counter. (4) The hands line a rectangular metal container with pre-cut sheets of white parchment paper, ensuring all sides are covered. (5) The hands place four dough balls into the lined container. Another shot shows a hand using a textured white rolling pin to flatten a piece of dough before rolling it into a cylinder. (6) Three larger rolled dough cylinders are placed side-by-side into a larger rectangular metal container. (7) The hands place two very large dough rolls into a third container. (8) Three containers filled with risen dough are seen inside a modern oven with a warm yellow light. (9) A hand uses a white silicone brush to coat the tops of the risen dough with yellow egg wash from a small glass cup. (10) The bread is shown inside the oven as it turns dark golden brown and expands. (11) A person wearing grey quilted oven mitts pulls the hot containers out of the oven. (12) A hand uses a green silicone brush to apply melted butter to the tops of the hot bread loaves on a wire cooling rack. (13) The hands gently press and pull apart the soft, fluffy bread, showing the white interior fibers. (14) A finished sandwich made with a slice of the bread, a fried egg, and green lettuce is shown on a black square plate.
